why_top: The lock-screen bite is the only one that would help me start without opening the app, which is my real problem. But I'll probably stop using the app in two weeks like every other one, so I don't know if I'd pay $1.99 for it.
why_least: A room I have to decorate with items I earn is one more thing to collect and manage, and I already have enough apps asking me to do that.
